provenance: Written against the folded inventory of logs/20261007_0_glm53_flash_h200_campaign/03_balanced_anchor_c32/profile_nsys (vLLM v0.31.0 fork, GLM-5.3-Flash FP8, H200 x4 on GPUs 4-7, TP4/DP1 without EP, BF16 KV, MTP 5, chunk 8192) and the glm53_flash_vllm_fp8_kda_dsa_moe_speculative cost manifest of the case-03 timing-predict (wt-glm53-h200-arch logs/20261008_0_h200_jitfill_03, attempt 7, branch glm53-flash-h200-arch at 8f6a96bb). gen_rules.py emits 344 candidates; the 82 that match no position at the fixpoint were dropped (344 -> 262) with labels verified identical. The label report still lists some rules as unfired: those match positions but are shadowed in the last sweep by a rule of the same operation, and they bootstrap chains at folded-body edges in earlier sweeps (removing them changes labels).
note: One order-free rule set: 0 disagreements at the fixpoint, 0 subsumptions. Forward-phase kernels are 100% mapped and draft-phase kernels 99.9%; the unmapped draft remainder is the copy + index launch after the last MTP step. Forward operations exclude the unified.mtp.* copy of their slot suffix; draft operations (mtp.*, phase draft) claim the mtp.step_0 and mtp.recurrent copies together. The FlashKDA q/k/v .contiguous() copies and beta transpose belong to kda.chunk_prefill, as the vllm_flashkda L1 kind times them. dsa.glue owns the dsa.glue, dsa.indexer_glue and dsa.prefill_glue placeholders together. dsa.sparse_mla is the one FA3 call per layer (prepare_varlen, mainloop and combine), and the 64-wide query zero fill is dsa.sparse_mla.q_rope_zero_fill. The draft metadata rebuild and input prep are mtp.step_glue. The draft logits all-gather and its concat copy are mtp.logits_gather, a synchronizing collective against an elementwise placeholder slot. Preprocess, sample plumbing and bookkeep stay explicitly unmapped. The exceptions are the sample-phase lm_head GEMM, which is mapped, and the sample logits all-gather, which is labeled as an unmapped synchronizing collective. Lone one-kernel repeat bodies of the KDA split gathers and FlashKDA copies are labeled by the <none>/<none> sentinel; in this capture no other forward kernel of those names folds that way.
